items.title:
# 標題：
比特幣挺過90美元油價和上升收益率，而黃金下滑。堅挺美元是陷阱

# 正文：
Bitcoin has proved resilient in the face of headwinds that typically weigh on risk assets. The leading cryptocurrency is up about 18% for the month, even as crude oil prices have climbed toward $90 a barrel and Treasury yields have surged higher—moves that typically create a challenging environment for speculative bets.

Gold, which often acts as a safe haven during times of risk-off sentiment, has slid 3% this month, reflecting some of the weakness in commodities broadly. But gold's decline has more to do with a surging U.S. dollar.

The dollar index has gained nearly 4% in November, the strongest month since May 2023. The strength in the U.S. currency is likely one reason why Bitcoin investors have remained relatively unfazed.

Historically, Bitcoin and the dollar have had a negative correlation, meaning they tend to move in opposite directions. But that relationship has weakened considerably during this particular rally in the dollar
items.fact: BTC 因油價 90 美元和債券殖利率上升對股票和黃金造成壓力而交投震盪。

items.title: 全球債券殖利率飆升 政府借貸面臨挑戰
items.fact: 利率上升浪潮對全球經濟造成深遠影響，從購屋者、信用卡持有人到各國政府都面臨沉重壓力。政府融資成本上升將限制財政支出空間，可能進一步衝擊經濟成長。

items.title: G20峰會因全球債市危機陷入爭執
items.fact: 財政部長會議在全球債券市場拋售、關稅爭議及各國公開言詞衝突的背景下結束。各國在地緣政治和貿易政策上的立場分歧愈發明顯，影響國際經濟合作。

verification.source: WSJ 華爾街日報（國際政經）
